name: plant-taxonomy
description: Query global plant taxonomic databases (GBIF, Kew WCVP/POWO, World Flora Online, IPNI, Catalogue of Life, and NCBI Taxonomy) to resolve botanical names, synonyms, protologues, APG IV lineages, and geographic distributions.
suggestedPrompts: Resolve the taxonomic status, basionym, and accepted name for Solanum lycopersicum
Compare the APG IV clade lineage and WFO/WCVP classification of Quercus robur
Standardize a list of plant species names and flag any synonyms or spelling variants
